fields.help: Absolute path of the file or folder to watch (~/ allowed). It need not exist yet.
fields.label: Path

fields.help: Comma-separated: add (a file appears), change (its content or size changes), unlink (it is removed). Empty: all three.
fields.label: Events

fields.help: Watch files in subfolders of a watched folder too.
fields.label: Include subfolders

fields.help: Comma-separated globs matched against each file's name and its path below the watched folder; a matching folder is skipped whole.
fields.label: Ignore

fields.help: How often the path is scanned for changes.
fields.label: Check every (seconds)
